name: Native Foods
notes: 3 photos, all menus: 1.jpg is a printed 'Guest Favorites' highlights board; 2.jpg/3.jpg are the front/back of a separate full paper menu (older Native Foods Cafe branding), merged as one document. The two boards overlap on several items (e.g. Buddha Bowl, Taco Salad, Twister Wrap, Meatball Sub, Chicken Run Ranch, BBQ Chicken Salad, Sweet Potato Fries) at different prices; kept the first (Guest Favorites) instance only and dropped the repeat to avoid duplicates. Multi-size items (wings, chili, soup) use the smaller/base price. All add-on/modifier lines (add avocado, add cheese, etc.) omitted per rules.

dishes.name: Chicken Wings
dishes.description: Crispy or grilled made-with-plants chicken wings, naked or with your choice of sauce (Buffalo or Thai Chili Cilantro). Served on a bed of shredded cabbage, carrots, and green onion, and with a side of ranch.

dishes.name: Spicy Cauliflower Dippers
dishes.description: Fried, panko-crusted cauliflower dippers with your choice of Buffalo or Thai Chili Cilantro sauce. Served on a bed of shredded cabbage, carrots, and green onion, and with a side of ranch.

dishes.name: Nachos
dishes.description: Corn tortilla chips, black beans and chipotle sauce, topped with cashew cheese, salsa fresca, roasted corn, green onions, cilantro and pickled jalapeño peppers.

dishes.name: Poppin' Jalapeño Burger
dishes.description: Two made-with-plants burger patties covered in American cheese. With pickled jalapeños, crispy onions, made-with-plants jalapeño-pimento cheese, lettuce, and green goddess dressing. Served on a toasted pretzel bun.

dishes.name: Gastropub Burger
dishes.description: A made-with-plants burger patty, tomato bacon jam, smoked Gouda, fried onion rings, arugula, and plant-based mayo. Served on a toasted pretzel bun.

dishes.name: Double Cheeseburger
dishes.description: Two made-with-plants burger patties covered in American cheese. With pickle chips, red onions, lettuce, Thousand Island dressing and BBQ sauce. Served on a toasted hamburger bun.

dishes.name: BBQ Brisket Burger
dishes.description: Brisket-style seitan, a made-with-plants burger patty, fried onion rings, smoked Gouda, Southern slaw, pickle chips, plant-based mayo, and BBQ sauce. Served on a toasted pretzel bun.

dishes.name: Orange Cauliflower
dishes.description: Crispy cauliflower tossed in a sweet and tangy orange sauce. On fried brown rice mixed with carrots, onions, peas and tofu scramble. Finished with sesame seeds and scallions.

dishes.name: Buddha Bowl
dishes.description: Teriyaki sweet potatoes, avocado, pineapple, shiitake mushroom chips, roasted corn, daikon sprouts, green onions, and jasmine rice.

dishes.name: Cauliflower Chickpea Shawarma Bowl
dishes.description: Shawarma chickpeas and cauliflower, creamy tahini sauce, and tomato cucumber salad. Served on quinoa, and topped with ranch, mint, and parsley.

dishes.name: Crazy Good Grilled Chicken Sandwich
dishes.description: Made-with-plants grilled chicken, smoked Gouda cheese, parmesan truffle potato chips, roasted tomatoes, arugula, and truffle aioli. Served on a toasted pretzel bun.

dishes.name: Cauliflower Chickpea Shawarma Wrap
dishes.description: Shawarma chickpeas and cauliflower, creamy tahini sauce, quinoa, tomato cucumber salad, ranch, mint, and parsley. Wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla.

dishes.name: The Real Nashville Hot
dishes.description: Spicy fried made-with-plants chicken tossed in a real Nashville hot sauce, topped with Southern slaw, pickle chips, and plant-based mayo. Served on a toasted hamburger bun.

dishes.name: Chicken, Bacon, Avo Club
dishes.description: Crunchy, herb-crusted made-with-plants chicken, seitan bacon, avocado, chipotle sauce, lettuce, tomatoes, and red onions. Served on a toasted sandwich roll.

dishes.name: Meatball Sub
dishes.description: Plant-based meatballs on a toasted baguette with truffle aioli, spicy marinara, melted smoked Gouda, arugula, and parmesan truffle potato chips.

dishes.name: Chicken Run Ranch
dishes.description: Crispy made-with-plants chicken, ranch dressing, lettuce, tomatoes and red onions, served on a toasted hamburger bun.

dishes.name: Twister Wrap
dishes.description: Made-with-plants crispy or grilled chicken, tossed in Buffalo sauce or naked. With avocado, mixed greens, cucumber salsa, and served with ranch or chipotle sauce. Wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla.

dishes.name: BBQ Chicken Salad
dishes.description: BBQ made-with-plants chicken with seitan bacon, roasted corn, organic black beans, jicama, salsa fresca, lettuce, avocado and pepitas. Served with green goddess dressing.

dishes.name: Taco Salad
dishes.description: A blend of seitan taco meat, lettuce, cabbage, salsa fresca, roasted corn, green onions, cilantro, and tortilla strips. Served with creamy chipotle dressing.

dishes.name: Seasonal Soup
dishes.description: Our kitchen's freshly prepared seasonal soups.

dishes.name: Native Chicken Wings
dishes.description: Native Chicken wings made the way you like 'em; crispy with or without buffalo sauce. Served with a side of ranch dressing.

dishes.name: Chili Cheese Fries
dishes.description: Thinly cut potatoes topped with Native chili, cashew cheese and red onions.

dishes.name: Native Nachos
dishes.description: Freshly prepared corn tortilla chips, black beans, chipotle sauce topped with cashew cheese, salsa fresca with roasted corn, green onions, cilantro and fresh jalapeño peppers.

dishes.name: Arancini
dishes.description: Two baked risotto balls stuffed with portobello and kalamata olives, served with harissa citrus tomato and pesto dipping sauces. Garnished with cashew parmesan cheese.

dishes.name: Japanese Sesame-Crusted Native Chicken Bites
dishes.description: Super Slaw, Japanese togarashi red-chili spice, mango-lime chili sauce.

dishes.name: Spicy Fried Cauliflower
dishes.description: Tossed in fiery chili sauce and sprinkled with sesame seeds. Served with cool ranch dip, cucumber coins, pickled homespun carrots and beets.

dishes.name: Fritters with Spicy Remoulade Sauce
dishes.description: Zucchini quinoa cakes drizzled with spicy chipotle remoulade. Served with fatoush salad; mixed greens, crispy baked pita croutons, cucumber and tomatoes, sprinkled with green onions and mint with a pomegranate molasses and balsamic dressing.

dishes.name: Green Goddess Salad
dishes.description: Shredded brussels sprouts, adzuki bean bacon sprinkled with shaved candied walnuts, fresh seasonal fruit and creamy jalapeño-cilantro-avocado dressing.

dishes.name: OC Raw Chopper
dishes.description: Freshly chopped mixed veggies, seasonal greens, salsa pomodoro, avocado, almonds, angel hair beets and sprouts. Tossed with lemon garlic vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Native Chopped Salad
dishes.description: Romaine, spring mix, Super Slaw, shredded carrots, red onions, jicama, Native Seitan Bacon, grilled Native Chicken, green onions, diced cucumber, salsa fresca, pumpkin seeds, croutons, and cilantro. Tossed in mango lime dressing.

dishes.name: Ensalada Azteca
dishes.description: Fresh avocado, jicama and cucumber salsa, quinoa, romaine, raisins, toasted pumpkin seeds and cilantro served with our mango lime vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Native Chili
dishes.description: Native Seitan chili meat simmered with tomatoes and spices, cashew cheese and red onions. Served with freshly baked cornbread.

dishes.name: Portobello Bourguignon Stew
dishes.description: A hearty stew of portobello mushrooms simmered in a rich red wine and thyme broth with carrots, Yukon potatoes, and celery.

dishes.name: Soul Bowl
dishes.description: Southern fried Native Chicken with organic red beans, organic brown rice, steamed veggies and kale topped with ranch and BBQ sauce. Served with fresh baked cornbread.

dishes.name: Thai Meatball
dishes.description: Seitan meatballs tossed with mango-lime chili sauce, roasted red peppers and lemongrass broccoli on a bed of quinoa with our Native Super Slaw.

dishes.name: Bangkok Curry Bowl
dishes.description: Seared organic tofu steak, steamed veggies, kale and organic brown rice with coconut milk red curry, sesame gomasio, and cilantro.

dishes.name: Moroccan
dishes.description: Organic tofu, marinated in Moroccan spices with grilled veggies, quinoa, raisins and toasted almonds.

dishes.name: Greek Gyro
dishes.description: Peppered seitan with shallots, quinoa, steamed veggies and kale, with lemon garlic sauce and hummus.

dishes.name: Sesame Kale Macro
dishes.description: Grilled tempeh atop steamed kale, organic brown rice, creamy ginger sesame sauce, and tangy sauerkraut. Garnished with toasted sesame seeds, green onions, served with crunchy cucumber seaweed salad on the side.

dishes.name: Baja Tacos
dishes.description: Three soft corn tortillas stuffed with blackened Native Tempeh, creamy chipotle sauce, salsa fresca and shredded cabbage.

dishes.name: Native Chicken, Bacon & Avo Club
dishes.description: Crunchy, herb-crusted Native Chicken, Native Seitan Bacon, avocado, chipotle sauce, romaine, tomato, red onions and carrots. Served on multi-grain ciabatta.

dishes.name: Barbecue Pulled Jack Sandwich
dishes.description: Barbecue jackfruit topped with siracha coleslaw, crispy shallots on a soft roll served with pickle chips.

dishes.name: Grilled Veggie Power Sandwich
dishes.description: Grilled zucchini, balsamic marinated portobello mushrooms, roasted red bell peppers, house-made tofu feta, greens and hummus on a multi-grain roll.

dishes.name: Oklahoma Classic
dishes.description: Native Seitan Bacon, melted cheddar, caramelized onions, organic tofu bacon, BBQ sauce, ranch dressing, carrots, tomato, red onions and romaine served on a whole-wheat bun.

dishes.name: Reuben
dishes.description: Thinly sliced deli-style Seitan on toasted rye with sauerkraut, cashew horseradish cheese, 1,000 island dressing, and freshly made pickle chips.

dishes.name: Big 'Ol BBQ Burger
dishes.description: Our signature savory patty with Native Seitan Bacon and melted cheddar cheese, crispy shallots, tangy BBQ sauce, creamy ranch, lettuce, and mayo, served on a whole-wheat bun.

dishes.name: Southwestern Burger
dishes.description: Our signature savory patty with guacamole, Santa Fe salsa and spicy grilled jalapeños, served on a multi-grain ciabatta.

dishes.name: Portobello & Sausage Burger
dishes.description: Grilled portobellos, Native Seitan patty, caramelized onions, sweet roasted garlic, pumpkin seed pesto, mayo, romaine and tomato, served on a whole-wheat bun.

dishes.name: Scorpion Burger
dishes.description: Blackened tempeh, chipotle sauce, romaine, carrots, red onions and avocado, served on a whole-wheat bun.

dishes.name: Native Chicken Strips
dishes.description: Native Chicken strips with homemade ranch dipping sauce.

dishes.name: Mac & Cheese
dishes.description: Super pasta in a cheese sauce.

dishes.name: Super Food Hot Chocolate Cream n' Spice
dishes.description: Power up your winter! Enjoy a toasty cup of hot chocolate slow cooked with turmeric and matcha. Topped with a frothy soy milk and sprinkled with cinnamon.

dishes.name: Salted Caramel Rice Treats with Chocolate Drizzle
dishes.description: Crispy and crunchy rice cereal and creamy peanut butter, topped with decadent chocolate drizzle.
